paper.title_en: Carrollian minimal massive gravity and the fate of third-way consistency
paper.abstract_en: We construct the Carrollian limit of minimal massive gravity. The limit is singular for the algebra and regular for the Chern-Simons-like data. The one divergent bracket points along the null direction of the contracted bilinear form. The Lagrangian is therefore finite while the brackets are not. The contracted curvature still obeys a cubic closure condition, forced on shell rather than identically. The third-way coupling itself, however, is removable. For generic parameters an invertible redefinition of the auxiliary field and the boost connection takes it to Carrollian topologically massive gravity up to a boundary term. The same redefinition fails before the limit. We solve for an anti-de Sitter vacuum and a Carrollian black hole, whose rotation parameter leaves the frame and survives only in the boost connection. The degenerate vector flavor metric obstructs the standard charge formula, which we replace by a canonical one. The boundary charges, obtained in two independent ways, carry no trace of the deformation. A Dirac analysis gives nine first-class constraints and no local degrees of freedom on any background. The massive graviton is removed. The asymptotic symmetry algebra is bms_3, with central charges carried by the Einstein and Lorentz-Chern-Simons terms. The black hole has two sets of thermodynamic data, each with its own first law. One obeys the Bekenstein-Hawking area law, the other keeps the Chern-Simons entropy.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文构造了minimal massive gravity的Carrollian极限，属于massive gravity家族（modified_gravity）；包含对称性代数、约束分析、渐近对称代数与黑洞热力学等多层理论内容，理论深度高；给出拉格朗日量、约束计数与两种独立途径求边界荷，方法信号较强；指出third-way耦合可被移除这一结论具有新颖性。新论文无引用属中性，未降低评分。
decision.title_zh: Carrollian 最小大质量引力与第三路一致性的命运
decision.abstract_zh: 我们构造了最小大质量引力的 Carrollian 极限。该极限对代数而言是奇异的，对 Chern-Simons 型数据而言则是正则的。唯一发散的括号指向收缩后双线性形式的零方向。因此拉格朗日量是有限的，而括号则不是。收缩后的曲率仍满足一个三次闭合条件，该条件是壳上强加的而非恒等成立的。然而，third-way 耦合本身是可移除的。对于一般参数，对辅助场和 boost 联络作一个可逆重定义，可将其（至多差一个边界项）化为 Carrollian 拓扑大质量引力。同一重定义在取极限之前失效。我们求解了一个反 de Sitter 真空和一个 Carrollian 黑洞，其旋转参数脱离标架，仅存留于 boost 联络之中。退化的矢量味度规阻碍了标准荷公式，我们以正则公式取而代之。用两种独立方法得到的边界荷不带有该形变的任何痕迹。Dirac 分析给出九个第一类约束，且在任意背景上都没有局部自由度。大质量引力子被移除。渐近对称代数 为 bms_3，其中心荷由 Einstein 项和 Lorentz-Chern-Simons 项承载。该黑洞有两组热力学数据，各自满足自己的第一定律。其中一组服从 Bekenstein-Hawking 面积定律，另一组则保留 Chern-Simons 熵。
